core_obligations: Reduce to the case of a polynomial ring over the base field by writing the smooth algebra as a localisation of an etale algebra (proof lines 13276-13300).
Use that formation of formal fibres and regularity behave well under etale maps and localisation (proof lines 13300-13320).
Compute the formal fibre in the polynomial case, where the completed local ring is a power series ring with the expected number of variables, and conclude regularity (proof lines 13320-13332).

Compute the power series case and conclude (proof lines 13320-13332).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the formal fibres of a smooth algebra over a field are regular, and the proof is a 57-line argument reducing to the polynomial case. It uses the structure of a smooth algebra over a field as a localisation of an etale algebra over a polynomial ring, the preservation of the property under etale maps and localisation, and the explicit identification of the completed local ring of a polynomial ring with a power series ring. The reductions are performed in order with the numerical invariant kept track of at each step.
